arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS population,
       MIN("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS min_recorded_rate,
       MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS max_recorded_rate,
       SUM("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" IS NULL) AS missing_rate,
       SUM("Free Meal Count (K-12)" = 0 AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0) AS zero_free_meals,
       MAX(ABS("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" - "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (K-12)", 0))) AS max_rate_difference
FROM main.frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0;
